s: Paul covets nothing (no one's silver, gold, or clothing)
q: I coveted no one’s silver, gold, or clothing.

s: Miletus is location of Paul's farewell speech (Paul summoned the Ephesian elders there)
q: From Miletus he sent to Ephesus and called to himself the elders of the assembly.

s: elders of the assembly (Ephesus) is from Ephesus
q: he sent to Ephesus and called to himself the elders of the assembly

s: elders of the assembly (Ephesus) is appointed overseers by Holy Spirit (to shepherd the assembly)
q: the flock, in which the Holy Spirit has made you overseers, to shepherd the assembly of the Lord and God

s: elders of the assembly (Ephesus) oversees flock (as overseers)

q: a plot was made against him by Jews as he was about to set sail for Syria

q: Men will arise from among your own selves, speaking perverse things, to draw away the disciples after them.

s: God purchased flock (with his own blood)
q: to shepherd the assembly of the Lord and God which he purchased with his own blood.

s: Paul's farewell speech quotes Jesus (It is more blessed to give than to receive)
q: to remember the words of the Lord Jesus, that he himself said, ‘It is more blessed to give than to receive.’

s: Paul is accompanied by Paul's travel companions (as far as Asia)
q: These accompanied him as far as Asia: Sopater of Beroea, Aristarchus and Secundus of the Thessalonians, Gaius of Derbe, Timothy, and Tychicus and Trophimus of Asia.

s: Paul's travel companions includes Timothy
q: Gaius of Derbe, Timothy, and Tychicus

s: Peter is a apostle
q: said to Peter and the rest of the apostles

s: David is a prophet
q: Therefore, being a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him

s: David is a patriarch
q: I may tell you freely of the patriarch David

s: David has tomb location with us (tomb remains to this day)
q: he both died and was buried, and his tomb is with us to this day.

s: disciples (believers gathered at Pentecost) receive Holy Spirit (filled at Pentecost)
q: They were all filled with the Holy Spirit

s: multitude (Jews in Jerusalem) includes devout Jews from every nation
q: Now there were dwelling in Jerusalem Jews, devout men, from every nation under the sky.

s: Pentecost is a day (the day the disciples were together)
q: Now when the day of Pentecost had come, they were all with one accord in one place.

s: speaking in other languages is enabled by Holy Spirit
q: began to speak with other languages, as the Spirit gave them the ability to speak.

s: Peter's Pentecost sermon is delivered by Peter
q: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice and spoke out to them

s: Peter stands with apostles (when speaking to the crowd)
q: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice

s: baptism and repentance leads to gift of the Holy Spirit

s: early church community life has practice having all things in common
q: All who believed were together, and had all things in common.

s: early church community life has practice selling possessions to meet needs
q: They sold their possessions and goods, and distributed them to all, according as anyone had need.

s: Jesus is a man approved by God (by mighty works, wonders and signs)

s: Jesus has status Lord and Christ (made so by God)
q: God has made him both Lord and Christ, this Jesus whom you crucified.

s: Jesus is exalted at right hand of God

s: Jesus was crucified by lawless men (who crucified Jesus) (delivered by God's determined counsel)

s: Jesus received from father promise of the Holy Spirit
q: having received from the Father the promise of the Holy Spirit

s: God raised up Jesus (freed him from the agony of death)
q: This Jesus God raised up, to which we all are witnesses.

q: God had sworn with an oath to him that of the fruit of his body, according to the flesh, he would raise up the Christ to sit on his throne

s: Philip is a evangelist
q: the house of Philip the evangelist, who was one of the seven

q: we have written our decision that they should observe no such thing, except that they should keep themselves from food offered to idols, from blood, from strangled things, and from sexual immorality.

q: I am a Jew from Tarsus in Cilicia, a citizen of no insignificant city.

q: One Ananias, a devout man according to the law

q: well reported of by all the Jews who lived in Damascus

s: Jesus is called Righteous One

s: the Way persecuted by Paul (formerly, to the death)
